description: Maple Oil processes three types of crude oil: light oil, non-sticky oil and heavy oil. Each tank of light oil produces a net revenue of $550, each tank of non-sticky oil produces a net revenue of $750, and each tank of heavy oil produces a net revenue of $950. To process a tank of light oil, 3 units of compound A and 3 units of compound B are required. To process a tank of non-sticky oil, 6 units of compound A and 2 units of compound B are required. To process a tank of heavy oil, 9 units of compound A and 3 units of compound B are required. Currently the company has 250 units of compound A and 150 units of compound B to process. How many full or partial tanks of each oil should the company process so that net revenue is maximized?

NumOilTypes.definition: Number of different types of crude oil

NumCompounds.definition: Number of different compounds required to process oil

NetRevenue.definition: Net revenue per tank for each type of crude oil

CompoundRequirement.definition: Amount of each compound required to process one tank of each type of crude oil

TotalCompoundAvailable.definition: Total units of each compound available for processing

objective.description: "Maximize the total net revenue from processing light oil, non-sticky oil, and heavy oil tanks"

constraints.description: The total amount of compound A used for processing light, non-sticky, and heavy oil must not exceed 250 units
The total amount of compound B used for processing light, non-sticky, and heavy oil must not exceed 150 units
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(CompoundRequirement[1][i] * TanksProcessed[i] for i in range(NumOilTypes))
    <= TotalCompoundAvailable[1]
)

constraints.description: The number of tanks of light oil, non-sticky oil, and heavy oil processed must be non-negative

TanksProcessed.definition: Number of full or partial tanks processed for each type of crude oil
